home_rows.advantage: From the rim road a lobber looks down the flume and the canal, two long held lines inside its 75 m range (lobber.gd:12).
home_rows.counter: Drop off the flume into the canal, or the other way: the shell lands on the line you left (lobber.gd:3-7).

home_rows.advantage: Drones roost on the flume itself, the longest held line in world 1; a 20 m winch lane along the trough (winch_drone.gd:15) hooks a ball that slows on the grind.
home_rows.counter: Hold 19 m/s and the cable snaps on its own (winch_drone.gd:20); a jump snaps it too.

home_rows.advantage: The wasteway floor is one straight concrete lane, the lane a chaser lunges down.
home_rows.counter: Pump the wasteway walls and come down on them from above the lane.

home_rows.advantage: The forecourt is the drum's front door, and a brute's 6 m slam ring (plated_brute.gd:12) covers the doorway every ground line rolls through.
home_rows.counter: Take the forecourt geyser over the ring into the drum, come off the bluff rim and land on the brute from above, or keep the flume's speed to the pour lip and drop into the drum over the doorway.

home_rows.advantage: A landed crew pits the bench a light ball crosses to reach the hauler.
home_rows.counter: Grow past the rating, or jump and smash the disc (mag_trapper.gd:6-9).

codex.title: Pressure keeps the change
codex.name: Pressure keeps the change
codex.hint: A cracked wheel beside a copper door.
codex.clue: Ram the valve on the Reach's west shelf + the copper door
codex.text: A rolling ram turns the old valve. Behind the sinking door, the crew's spare parts wait.

codex.title: Overtime Locker
codex.name: Overtime Locker
codex.hint: A cracked wall on the canal grade, looking at the hollow.
codex.clue: Ram the cracked wall on the canal grade, west of the trestle hollow
codex.text: The flume crew bricked up their overtime locker so the timesheets would match. The timesheets still do not match.
